cards.card_text: Then the LORD speaks to Abram, and it’s a BIG ask: “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household…”
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.

cards.card_text: Esther tells King Xerxes she can't bear to see the ___ of her kindred.
cards.verse_text: How could I bear to see the destruction of my kindred?”
cards.snippet: How could I bear to see the destruction of my kindred?”

cards.card_text: God tells him, ‘Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.’ No name, no map, and Abraham GOES: first to Haran, then, after his father dies, into the land the council is living in now.
cards.verse_text: and told him, ‘Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.’ So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran.
cards.snippet: and told him, ‘Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.’ So Abraham left…
